testimonials:

  - hub: West Nile Virus Forecasting Hub
    name: Dr. Héctor M. Sánchez C
    img: /includes/img/HMSC.png
    testimonial: |
      We wanted to launch the first West Nile Virus Forecasting Challenge in the state of California to support existing efforts in reducing disease prevalence. **The hubverse tools have been a crucial component in our setup** as they allow for standard submission formats and validations, which encourage participation and collaborations from external teams.
    org:
      slug: cadph
      name: California Department of Public Health

  - hub: Paraguay Forecast Hub
    name: Dr. Spencer J Fox
    img: /includes/img/sjf.png
    testimonial: |
      Hubverse tools have been instrumental in enabling us to scale infectious disease forecasting globally, including to regions that have historically lacked access to real-time forecasts. Their standardized, flexible infrastructure makes it possible to rapidly deploy and coordinate forecasting efforts across many regions.
    org:
      slug: uscdc
      name: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
